description: zn-gate: keep secret values out of tool calls, tool output and prompts. Every hook runs scripts/zn-hook.sh (macOS and Linux) or scripts/zn-hook.ps1 (Windows), which runs the pinned, verified zn-gate copy inside this plugin and blocks (exit 2) when it cannot.

args: try { & ([scriptblock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText($env:ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT + '/scripts/zn-hook.ps1'))) 'UserPromptSubmit' } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('zn: the plugin launcher (scripts/zn-hook.ps1) could not run. This call was blocked because zn could not check it. Ask the user to fix it, or to turn off the zn-gate plugin in ZCode (Settings, Plugins).'); exit 2 }; exit 2

try { & ([scriptblock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText($env:ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT + '/scripts/zn-hook.ps1'))) 'PreToolUse' } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('zn: the plugin launcher (scripts/zn-hook.ps1) could not run. This call was blocked because zn could not check it. Ask the user to fix it, or to turn off the zn-gate plugin in ZCode (Settings, Plugins).'); exit 2 }; exit 2

try { & ([scriptblock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText($env:ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT + '/scripts/zn-hook.ps1'))) 'PermissionRequest' } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('zn: the plugin launcher (scripts/zn-hook.ps1) could not run. This call was blocked because zn could not check it. Ask the user to fix it, or to turn off the zn-gate plugin in ZCode (Settings, Plugins).'); exit 2 }; exit 2

try { & ([scriptblock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText($env:ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT + '/scripts/zn-hook.ps1'))) 'PostToolUse' } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('zn is NOT protecting this session: the plugin launcher (scripts/zn-hook.ps1) could not run.'); exit 0 }; exit 0
